title: PinnedVersion

anyOf.description: A release's version: a semantic version without the tag's v (0.4.2, 1.0.0-beta.2); one with a prerelease part is a prerelease, which only the beta channel follows.

description: An exact version to run on any channel, without the tag's v, or null for none. While one is set auto-update is off; clearing it returns to the auto-update switch.
